create_phi4multimodal_processor: create a Phi4MultimodalProcessor instance with image_processor, audio_processor, and tokenizer components
call_processor_with_multimodal_input: call the Phi4MultimodalProcessor with text, images, and audio to produce tokenized BatchFeature output
validate_image_token_count: validate that the number of image tokens in the prompt matches the count of provided images
validate_audio_token_count: validate that the number of audio tokens in the prompt matches the count of provided audio inputs
expand_image_audio_tokens: expand image and audio placeholder tokens in text to the correct number of repeated tokens per input
